description: Username ideas for Instagram or TikTok from a name, keywords and a niche. Every idea follows the platform's rules (Instagram: up to 30 characters, lowercase letters, numbers, periods and underscores; TikTok: 2 to 24 characters, letters, numbers, underscores and periods). Give at least one of name, keywords or niche. Whether a handle is free on the platform is not checked.

keywords.description: Up to 5 words that describe the account.

name.description: A person's or brand's name, for example 'Anna Rivera'.

seed.description: Optional: another number gives another set of ideas. The same input and seed always give the same ideas.

name: username_ideas
title: Instagram and TikTok username ideas
